messages:
michael_p: Heads-up — onboarding for eu-north-1b region routing + residency checks. Need owners for routing policy, KMS key policy, peering, and canary plan before we flip DNS. cc @linda_eng @ana_sre @sophia_pm

linda_eng: Infra check: control-plane subscriptions are provisioned. KMS key needs a restrictive key policy and a few CMK aliases. I'll open a PR for the key policy today.

ana_sre: SRE checklist question — will all ingest/log endpoints be pinned to eu-north? Compliance needs an auditable evidence bundle showing no egress to non-eu.

sophia_pm: Milestone reminder: target cutover 2024-11-06 (canary 11-05). Current blockers: KMS policy, peering confirmation, and NAT/egress review. Legal needs residency note for final go/no-go.

ryan_net: Network side: peering slot tentatively scheduled for 2024-11-01 maintenance window. We'll need a dedicated /26 for LB frontends and route table entries. Who is owning the route table updates?

michael_p: I'll own route-table updates and the DNS flip. For routing policy schema, see infra repo snippet below — @linda_eng can you review and align KMS alias naming?

```yaml
routing_policy:
  region: eu-north-1b
  prefer_local: true
  fallbacks:
    - region: eu-west-1
      type: cost-latency
  kms_key_alias: alias/redwood/eu-north-1b
  residency_label: eu-only
```

linda_eng: PR opened: infra/ops#2332 - kms policy + alias naming. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/2332 :thumbsup: I'll add a short migration plan for existing keys.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: peering-job created (job-id: peer-20241101-eunorth). Scheduled start: 2024-11-01T02:00:00Z.

luna_prod: I'll draft the canary traffic plan and a minimal rollback runbook. Plan to have a draft by 2024-11-05 morning.

michael_p: Quick architecture Q: do we want forced-local routing (reject cross-region) or local-first with fallback to us-west for non-PHI traffic? I lean local-first with fallback for availability.

ana_sre: SRE prefers local-first + explicit metrics for fallback events. I'll add synthetic checks and an alert if fallback rate > 1% over 10m. Also need to validate that audit logs show KMS key usage from eu endpoints only.

sophia_pm: Action items updated: 1) Merge KMS PR (owner: linda_eng) 2) Confirm peering & CIDR (owner: ryan_net) 3) Route table updates + DNS flip (owner: michael_p) 4) Compliance artifact + legal sign-off (owner: sophia_pm) 5) Canary plan + rollback (owner: luna_prod). Please add any missing owners.

michael_p: Thanks — I'll update the project board and link the infra PRs. If no objections, @linda_eng please aim to merge KMS PR by EOD tomorrow so network can finalize peering.

linda_eng: Will do. If I hit blockers I'll ping here with details.

ana_sre: I'll start the synthetic check templates and post them in the SRE requests thread for review.

michael_p: Great. Closing the loop here — will post an updated checklist after PR merge and when peering job is green.
